verses.text: Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Let those the LORD has rescued say so, those he rescued from the power of the enemy,
those he gathered from other lands, from the east and the west, from the north and the south.
Some wandered in the wilderness, on desert paths. They found no city to live in.
They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives were slipping away.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he rescued them from their distress.
He led them on a straight path to a city where they could live.
Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people!
He satisfies those who are thirsty. He fills the hungry with good things.
Some sat in darkness and deep gloom, prisoners suffering in iron chains,
because they had rebelled against God's words and rejected the advice of the Most High.
So he humbled them with hard work. They fell down, and no one helped them.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
He brought them out of darkness and deep gloom and broke their chains.
Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people!
He breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.
Some were foolish and suffered because of their rebellion and their sins.
They could not stand the sight of food. They came close to the gates of death.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
He sent out his word and healed them. He rescued them from the grave.
Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people!
Let them offer sacrifices of thanks and tell about what he has done with songs of joy.
Some went out to sea in ships, doing business on the great waters.
They saw what the LORD can do, his amazing works in the deep sea.
He spoke, and a storm wind rose up and lifted the waves high.
The ships rose up to the sky and went down to the depths. The sailors lost their courage in their danger.
They rolled and staggered like drunks. They did not know what to do.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.
He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves became still.
They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to the harbour they wanted.
Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people!
Let them honour him in the gathering of the people and praise him in the meeting of the leaders.
He turns rivers into desert and flowing springs into thirsty ground.
He turns fruitful land into a salty wasteland, because of the evil of the people who live there.
He turns the desert into pools of water and dry ground into flowing springs.
He brings the hungry to live there, and they build a city to live in.
They plant fields and vineyards, and gather a rich harvest.
He blesses them, and their numbers grow greatly. He does not let their herds get smaller.
Then their numbers become fewer, and they are humbled by cruelty, trouble, and sorrow.
He pours shame on rulers and makes them wander in a wasteland with no paths.
But he lifts the needy out of their suffering and makes their families grow like flocks of sheep.
Honest people see it and are glad, and all the wicked shut their mouths.
Whoever is wise, let them think about these things and consider the faithful love of the LORD.
